page.layout: One column of text with a large woodcut initial; a right margin note beside the second half of the text; a catchword at the lower right and a signature at the foot. The heading is a title at the top, centred, above the text.

main_text.head: DE AGRO FRISIÆ INTER AMASVM ET LAVICAM FLVMINA.
main_text.p: Vrbs GRONINGA proximis aliquot saeculis amplissima, splendidissima, & validissima in Frisijs fuit: eademq; situ pene medio regionis ab occidente in orientem porrecta, ideoq; omnib. fere rebus ejus magnis bello ac pace implicita; denique reip. forma prae cateris insignis, atq; optime habens. Quapropter opera pretium visum, seorsim quaedam de ea differere, & explicare accuratius, eaq; explicatione lucem affundere multis partibus historia no-stratis.Summa ope-ris & ordo. Et primum quidem de agro dicam bre-viter, in quo urbs sita est, deq; fluminib. agrum percurrentibus: tum de ipsa urbe, de jure VLTRAIECTINO, de pactis & foederibus ejus, de conatu & armis SAXONVM, DE EDSAR-DI, GELDRI, BVRGVNDORVM imperio, summatim agam; post de αὐτονο-[?]

page.notes: The heading is a title, so it has no caput. The woodcut initial V is joined to "rbs" as "Vrbs". The right margin note is set on two lines, "Summa ope" / "ris & ordo."; the hyphen after "ope" is not clearly visible, so it may not be printed. The Greek at the line end ("&vtovo-") is read as αὐτονο-, with the "&" possibly a Greek alpha; the reading is doubtful. The catchword "μία" is read as μίᾳ with the iota subscript uncertain. The page number 17 is printed at the upper right. No running head is printed on this page.
